```python
def adb_signature(payload):
    if len(payload) < 24:
        return None
    command, arg0, arg1, length, check, magic = struct.unpack('<6I', payload[:24])
    if command ^ magic != 0xffffffff:
        return None
    if command == CNXN:
        if length > ADB_BODY_LIMIT or len(payload) != 24 + length:
            return None
        body = payload[24:]
        if checksum(body) != check:
            return None
        try:
            banner = body.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeError:
            return None
        return ('CNXN', (arg0 >> 16) & 255, (arg0 >> 8) & 255, arg0 & 255, banner)
    if command == AUTH:
        if length > ADB_BODY_LIMIT or len(payload) != 24 + length:
            return None
        body = payload[24:]
        if checksum(body) != check:
            return None
        return ('AUTH', arg0, arg1, body)
    return None
```
